trigger.interpretation: The first frozen pool was two structures short after seven hidden-covalent structures and ten other coordinate failures were excluded. No docking or ligand-label evidence was used.

scope: Keep every title, mutation, sequence, ligand-location, ATP-pocket, covalency, alignment, structural-feature, and max-min rule unchanged. Expand only the metadata resolution ceiling from 2.5 A to the conventional 3.0 A boundary, using the already frozen RCSB metadata snapshot.

metadata_pool_expansion.new_admission_rule: previous exclusion_reasons must equal resolution_above_limit and resolution_angstrom must be at most 3.0

rules_retained_without_change.coordinate_gate: all amendment01 coordinate and hidden-covalency rules
rules_retained_without_change.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural distance seeded by EGFR_2RGP_reference
rules_retained_without_change.failure_action: stop without ligand-panel docking if the expanded pool still yields fewer than 16 coordinate-eligible structures

authorization: Download and audit only the 27 deterministically newly admitted candidates, combine them with the 14 already coordinate-eligible structures, and rerun the unchanged structural max-min selection.
interpretation_boundary: This prospective pool expansion addresses receptor availability only. It does not rescue any failed coordinate structure, use activity labels, or relax the covalency and ATP-pocket gates; passing still cannot establish docking validity or any QUBO or quantum claim.
